title: Type checking without TypeScript files: @ts-check and JSDoc with tsc --noEmit, adopted layer by layer, rather than converting to .ts
context: Owner, 2026-10-05: a friend says using JavaScript was a terrible decision and the project should be TypeScript. Discussed; the owner asked to keep the recommendation as a roadmap item that might be implemented in the future.
outcome: Not scheduled. When picked up: keep .js and the no-build setup, add // @ts-check with JSDoc types and a tsc --noEmit check beside npm run architecture, starting with src/domain as a trial, then src/core and src/content, then src/fx, src/td-tab.js last. ROADMAP.md, Candidate: 'Type checking without TypeScript files'.
alternatives: Converting to .ts: a compile step between editing and running for the build, the Node tests and the browser, and typing hundreds of loosely shaped host objects; weeks of churn mid-playtest
Staying untyped: the tests, the architecture guard and the asset locks catch behaviour, not shapes; this session's lit?.() on false and the headWas name clash were shape bugs
evidence: Discussion with the owner, 2026-10-05; nothing implemented
